about: WLD-83 (Darko 2026-10-22 15:41): the likeness form shows by example what the town makes from a resident's picture and appearance. Only Darko's own household may appear (Rei, Wright and the meeps): nobody else has consented to being an example. A url is a media-door URL, filled once Darko has approved the image and it is uploaded; an entry with no url is not shown. src/likeness-pages.mjs § galleryFor keeps only the household below, and only while its likeness answer is yes.
